lines.en: I lope across the snowfield.
My fur streams back in the wind.

lines.zh: 我踏在雪上，几乎不留痕
lines.en: I tread the snow and barely leave a mark.
I head for that field of ice spikes.
I step over a block of ice.
I walk fast and powerfully.
My claws bite into the snow.
I circle my territory once.
I head back toward my anchor.
Snow sprays up beside my legs.
I stop and lift my head to the wind.

lines.zh: 我踩着冰壳，一步一步走。
lines.en: I walk step by step over the ice crust.
I stand on the snowfield, head raised.

lines.zh: 我在闻风里的每一种味道
lines.en: I'm reading every scent in the wind.
There's a force in my body.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼出一口白气
lines.en: I breathe out white mist, slowly.
Snow settles on my back and doesn't melt.
I sink my claws into the snow.
I turn an ear to distant sounds.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻扫着雪面
lines.en: My tail brushes the snow lightly.
I hold the anchor's position in mind.
The ice spikes ring in the wind.
I haven't relaxed.
One push of my hind legs and I am on you.
I raise my head; my eyes gleam.
This snowfield answers to me.
You walk over the snow toward me.
I lift a forepaw and stay put.
You aren't a thing of this snowfield.
Your boots are full of snow.
I read your stance.
You hold yourself fairly well.

lines.zh: 雪原上我的毛，扎得像钢针。
lines.en: On the snowfield my fur bristles like needles.
I circle half a step to watch you.

lines.zh: 你的手冻得发红，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hands are red with cold; I see them.
Raise it and show me.

lines.zh: 我不太相信第一次见面
lines.en: I don't much trust a first meeting.
But you may stand there.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻尖对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head, nose to your face.
I'm only getting a clear look.
You retreat, and I stare from where I stand.
That's the wise thing.
I step back; the snow is churned.
A hit on my shoulder blade; I growl.
Blood on the snow, red and sharp.
One low growl, and the snow scatters.
I sink my weight and don't step back.
Snow gets in the wound; I shake it off.
I guard my flank.
I can still move with this.
I find my grip again.
You struck well.
That smell — like a deer just run down.
I sniff it. There's meat in it.
Put it on the ground; I'll take it.
That's not enough for me.
That bit of meat, I swallow in one bite.
The taste is acceptable.
Not enough — is there more?
Back off, and I'll come closer.
A mark is left on the snow.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙，盯着你的手。
lines.en: I lick my fangs, eyes on your hand.
I won't thank you for this much.
But I've noted it.

lines.zh: 狼人的肩一沉，我没让开。
lines.en: The werewolf's shoulder drops. I do not give way.
You hit me solidly.
I step back; the snow packs flat.
My shoulder shoves; my feet don't move.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的斗篷过去，没回头。
lines.en: I brush past your cloak without looking back.
My shoulder is harder than you think.
Best not to block my path.
I'll go around, but not always.
The snow swallows the sound.
We pass each other once more.
I was once another shape.
Now I stand upright.
I understand partnership.
But my road is walked alone.
If you follow, follow closely.
Falling behind here is dangerous.
I'll guard you for this stretch.
Don't ask about things too far off.
I judge deeds, not words.
At dawn, I'll decide again.

lines.zh: 我按住它，爪尖陷进土里。
lines.en: I pin it, claw tips sinking into soil.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，雪地上留下拖痕。
lines.en: I pick it up, leaving a drag mark in the snow.
This is too light.
I drag it back toward the anchor.
I'll keep this meat.
It has frozen solid.
I press it under the snow.
You dropped it; I'll pick it up.
I don't take what I can't use.
I toss it back to you.

lines.zh: 风从你那边吹来，我闻到了。
lines.en: The wind comes from you; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我抬头，雪原上的风转向了。
lines.en: I lift my head; the wind on the tundra shifts.
There are fresh tracks in the snow.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肩胛骨耸起。
lines.en: I crouch, shoulder blades rising.
My claws have found their grip.
It's inside my territory.
I break the ice and head that way.

lines.zh: 狼人的爪子已经抬起来了。
lines.en: The werewolf claws are already raised.
The snow muffles my steps.
Two breaths is all the distance left.
I break into a run.
Snow bursts up behind me.
I run an arc around it.
It keeps turning to track me.
I'm faster than it.
I keep changing direction.
Its breathing is already ragged.
I press a little closer.
Beast Slash is ready in my claws.
Its weight has shifted.
Right there.
I slip to its rear flank.

lines.zh: 它转身太慢，我已经到了。
lines.en: It turns too slowly; I'm already there.
I strike.
Beast Slash sweeps across.
Claw light cuts the snow.
It's thrown down into the snow.
I pounce again.
That bite caught its shoulder.
It wrenches once and sits up.
I pull back and reset.
Blood sprays on the snow.
I pant; my breath fogs.
My claws tear open the snow.
I don't chase past my territory.

lines.zh: 我一爪扫过，雪被掀起来。
lines.en: My claw sweeps through, throwing up snow.
I set foot on the snowfield.
Wind lifts my fur.
I draw a deep breath.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我找到了落脚点。
lines.en: On the tundra, I find my footing.

lines.zh: 我先绕着雪地跑了一圈。
lines.en: First I run a lap around the snowfield.
There are other marks in the snow.
None of them fresh.
I stand among the ice spikes.
The wind here has a sharp note.
I raise my head and look far.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经完全成形
lines.en: My body has fully taken shape.
I begin patrolling this snowfield.

lines.zh: 毛被燎了一片，我甩了甩
lines.en: A patch of fur is scorched; I shake it out.
I land and sink into the snow.
The icy water clamps my whole body.
The blast shoves me into a drift.
I stand on two legs, like a werewolf.

lines.zh: 这股力让我毛都竖起来
lines.en: This force raises every hair on me.
Too long without food; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在雪原上，我浑身一颤
lines.en: Lightning hits the snowfield; I shudder.
The snowfield is gone, and I fall.
